coverage.checked: API release index/current V4.1 announcement; R1/Janus/Prover/OCR repos and author paper
coverage.verified_latest: V4.1-Flash 2026-09-10; prior Flash retired; Pro API continues after 2026-09-14 per updated official changelog
coverage.remaining: LLM/Coder/VL size variants and every historical snapshot not exhaustively expanded. OCR2 date preserved pending exact release-date evidence.

coverage.checked: Model Studio API lifecycle, Qwen3.8 repository chronology, Qwen image/audio/math/embedding/coder family sources
coverage.verified_latest: Sep24 Decision-Model-Preview remains latest dated catalog family; existing Sep17-21 Omni/LiveTranslate/Audio records present
coverage.remaining: Every legacy Qwen size, fine-tuning checkpoint, quantization and regional duplicate not expanded. API launch dates differ from blog dates and snapshot suffixes; do not collapse stages.

coverage.checked: Official foundation-blog index, latest research page, Seed2.0/2.1 tier declarations, Seed-Coder/Seed-OSS repos, Seed3D/SeedEdit/Prover announcements
coverage.verified_latest: Seed2.1 June23; Seedream5Pro July8; SeedAudio1 July20; Seedance2.5 July31; SeedRealtime exists in current research page
coverage.remaining: Legacy Seed-TTS/ASR, Seedance Lite tiers and every Volcano snapshot remain coverage gaps; no dates invented. Research Prover/Diffusion milestones must not imply public API or open weights.

coverage.checked: Complete current BigModel overview catalog excluding third-party Vidu; official international changelog; GLM4/4.5 sources
coverage.verified_latest: GLM5.3-Flash Aug26; GLM5.3-FlashX current identity verified but first date pending
coverage.remaining: GLM5 Feb11 vs Feb12, GLM5.1 Mar27 vs Apr7 and GLM5.3 Aug14 vs Aug18 are region/announcement conflicts; do not overwrite earliest dates solely from international release log. GLM5V-Turbo exact first date unresolved.

coverage.checked: Kimi official blog, Code model-release changelog, Kimi-VL repo
coverage.verified_latest: K2.8 Preview Sep11 Code rollout confirmed; K3 July16 API announcement confirmed
coverage.remaining: K3 launch blog promises weights byJuly27 while retrospective Code note calls July16 open; keep July16 as API stage, do not claim same-day weights. Early k0/k1 public release dates not reverified.

coverage.checked: ERNIE official blog/current repo; PaddleOCR release chronology
coverage.verified_latest: ERNIE5.1 May9 official announcement; PaddleOCR-VL1.6 May28 missing and now proposed
coverage.remaining: ERNIE5.1 Preview April29 not established by April30 leaderboard announcement; retain uncertainty. ERNIE5 formal model appears on Jan15 leaderboard before Jan22 launch; stages differ. Every ERNIE4.5 size and old cloud speed/lite variant not expanded.

coverage.checked: Official Hy4 newsroom; ASR product log; current organization, OCR, translation, dense, 3D and video repositories
coverage.verified_latest: Hy4 Preview Aug28 verified; HyASR3 preview Aug4 verified
coverage.remaining: HyImage3.5 preview Sep21 and HYWorld2.1 July are still pending exact first-release confirmation. Do not treat future Hy4-series promises as released.

coverage.checked: Official complete current models catalog and release log
coverage.verified_latest: M3.1-Flash-Preview current official availability confirmed but first date unresolved; retain visibly with d:null
coverage.remaining: H3 Max is explicitly a fal.ai post-trained derivative, not a new MiniMax-authored base model; excluded. Highspeed API variants share stated capability. Legacy abab variants not exhaustively dated.

coverage.checked: Current official product site, 3.5/3.7 blogs and official image/audio/3D repos
coverage.verified_latest: Step5 Preview present in catalog; October15 open-weight promise remains future as of cutoff. StepAudio3 family already in data.
coverage.remaining: Step3.5Flash exact first date not visible in retrieved primary pages; retain pending. StepAudio3 paper/API stages already distinguished; Step5 Sep20 not independently date-resolved in this pass.

coverage.checked: Official SparkAPI/current MaaS catalog, SparkX2.5 repo, iFlytek education corporate article
coverage.verified_latest: X2.5 flagship Sep7 and open1.7B/4B Sep1 verified separately
coverage.remaining: X2 February11 first-release claim conflicts with API document updateFebruary9 and remains unverified. X2VL June11 current third-party government evidence not independently upgraded to issuer first source.

notes: verified means the proposed identity/date-stage is directly supported by the cited official source; not a claim all historical records are verified.
date_pending entries should remain visible in a catalog and not get a fabricated timeline day.
Recommended lane labels are implementation suggestions; renderer must not imply sibling retirement just because a different capability variant was added.
Research reports/previews and API/open-weight releases must be shown distinctly. No future planned weight release should be labeled completed.

final_review_corrections.finding: Official changelog reverses initial planned routing: V4 Pro API continues after 2026-09-14 with unchanged billing. Remove end; prior routing proposal is superseded.
